Got Questions?

Frequently Asked Questions

Everything you need to know before you enroll.

Do I need experience to take these courses? +
No experience is needed for most courses. Course 01 — Prep, Application & Shaping is designed specifically for beginners and self-taught nail techs. The bundle takes you from zero to business-ready.
How do I access my course after purchasing? +
After your payment is confirmed you will receive an email instantly with your course access link. All course materials are hosted digitally and available immediately.
How long do I have access to the courses? +
Lifetime access. Once you purchase a course it is yours forever. You can revisit the material as many times as you need and receive any future updates at no additional cost.
Is the Complete Collection worth it compared to buying individually? +
Absolutely. The Complete Collection gives you all 6 courses for $2,497 — saving you $185 compared to buying each course individually. It is the fastest and most affordable way to get the complete education.
What is included in the digital book? +
Mastering Acrylic Application is a 100+ page PDF workbook that covers step-by-step acrylic application, printable worksheets, skill-building exercises, instructor guides, and troubleshooting tips. It is an instant download delivered to your email.
What payment methods do you accept? +
We accept all major credit and debit cards (Visa, Mastercard, Amex), Cash App Pay, and Klarna (buy now, pay later) through our secure Stripe checkout.
Do you offer refunds? +
Due to the digital nature of our products, all sales are final. We encourage you to review the course descriptions carefully before purchasing. If you have questions before buying, reach out to us directly.
